evidence: As visitors ascend the breezy staircase axis of the Vietnamese Women's Museum on Lý Thường Kiệt Street, they are invited to step into the 3rd Floor space, themed "Women and History." This sacred chronicle unfolds, sketching the tragic yet proud portrait of women throughout the nation's history.
